rationale: These seven files were picked because they carry the shapes that made TypeScript the worst-covered of the eight languages: against the pre-ATL-096 walker they measure 0.486 / 0.217, close to the 0.229 / 0.085 the whole 53-file repo scored. constants.ts opens with a module-scope IIFE containing an object getter, delay.ts nests `function abortHandler()` inside a callback, body.ts and http-error.ts pass object-literal methods to `new TransformStream({transform() {}})` / `new ReadableStream({start() {}})`, and headers.ts assigns a named class expression to `globalThis.Headers`. READ THIS BEFORE ASSUMING named_funcs IS A BUG. named_funcs asserts only the forms that must be entities: `function_declaration` anywhere, and `method_definition` inside a `class_body`. The other 36 of the fixture's 70 method_definitions (181 of 223 across the whole repo) hang off an object literal in argument position or an inline return, and this walker declines them — ADR-0031's test is whether a developer has a name for the thing, and the grammar node's spelling is not that test. `ky(url, {async fetch() {...}})` produces a `method_definition`, but the method belongs to an anonymous inline object and nothing can refer to it, so it is a callback exactly like the arrow it could have been written as. An object-literal method becomes an entity only when its object is itself bound (a const/let/var, a class field, or a property chain that reaches one) under a chain of named scopes, and is then named through that binding: `handlers.fetch`. Those captures are a bonus, not an assertion. The proof that declining is a naming decision rather than a walker hole is that `calls` does not move: declining an entity relocates its calls to the enclosing named scope, it does not lose them. The 0.4% call shortfall is 5 nodes of 1208, each naming nothing a graph could point at — 3 IIFEs `(() => {...})()`, whose callee is the arrow literal itself; 1 `super(...)`, already recorded as the class's INHERITS edge; and 1 `response[type]()`, a computed member resolved at runtime. Repo-wide the same kinds account for 16 of 6508 (0.25%), adding curried `promisify(fn)()` and dynamic `import('...')`, a module specifier rather than a callable. max_duplicate_uids is 0 as of ATL-107 (ADR-0032). It was 10 here and 57 on the full checkout, every one of them a `const customFetch = async () => {...}` (or `const fetch`, `const customJitter`) declared inside a sibling anonymous `test(...)` callback — 8 in http-error.ts and 4 in headers.ts on the fixture, 65 bodies sharing 8 uids across ky's test tree. ADR-0031 category 2 made them entities because they are bound to a name; ADR-0032 adds the condition that makes the name usable, namely that every scope enclosing the binding must itself be named, since the callback between the binding and the module has none and a positional name is banned. The walker now declines 13 entities on the fixture (Callables 65 -> 52) and 67 on the checkout (186 -> 119): 12 and 65 of those were the colliding ones, the remainder solitary consts of the identical shape (`stream.ts`'s lone `customFetch`, and ky's `const schema = {'~standard': {validate() {}}}` whose binding chain is intact but starts inside a callback). Not one declined entity is under ky's `source/` tree — all 67 are in `test/`. Both ratios are byte-identical before and after: named_funcs 1.000 and 1203/1208 calls here, 1.000 and 6492/6508 on the checkout. Category 1 is deliberately untouched: a `function` or `class` declares its own name rather than borrowing a variable's, so `function abortHandler()` inside `delay`'s `new Promise((resolve, reject) => {...})` callback keeps its entity as `delay.abortHandler`, and so do ky's two other nested declarations in test/memory-leak.ts. That carve-out is exactly what holds named_funcs at 1.000; a strict reading of ADR-0032 that disqualified them too would drop it to 0.974 here and 0.949 on the checkout while removing no collision. METRIC CORRECTED 2026-08-06: named_funcs read 0.51 here and 0.254 on ky because LangSpec counted every `method_definition` as a form that must become an entity. `method_definition` now asserts only inside a `class_body`, and all 42 such nodes in ky are captured. The floor is 1.0 rather than a margin below, because the denominator is now exactly the forms that must be entities.
